question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**connecting**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Blank no. 3 refers to 'Pathos', which means appealing to emotions.
 
• The verb needed must express forming an emotional link with the audience.
 
• **"Connecting"** fits perfectly because pathos is about 'connecting with the audience’s emotions'.
 
• Other options like "disparate", "distinct", or "unlike" do not express emotional engagement.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Disparate: **different in kind; unrelated — does not fit.
 
• **Distinct: **clearly different — not about emotional engagement.
 
• **Unlike: **not similar — grammatically incorrect in context.
